requirement: Each requirement and example definition badge MUST link to its evidence detail page, and each rendered requirement and example MUST be followed by a "See evidence" link to that page. Each detail page MUST link back to the definition's anchored badge and, when an index exists, to the index. Reference badges MUST continue to link to the definition. These links MUST resolve when a requirement name contains `.md`, as in `requirements.cli.mdbook`.
rationale:
**Judgment: the requirement is met.** The implementation covers every obligation and the tests exercise each one. Two small marking and test-labelling oddities are noted at the end; neither is a gap in behaviour. **Implementation** - **Badge links to the detail page.** `replace_definitions` (src/lib.rs:285) computes `detail_href` with `chapter_href(current, plan.detail_path(name))`. It renders the definition badge as ``, so the badge links to the detail page. This applies to both requirements and examples. Terms are handled separately and are outside this requirement. - **"See evidence" link.** The same function appends `

See evidence

` after each rendered requirement or example body. It adds the link only when a detail page exists. - **Detail page links back to the badge and the index.** `render_detail_page` (src/index.rs:468) emits `[View definition](chapter_href(detail_path, definition.path, Some(kind.anchor(name))))`. The anchor is the same `habeas-{badge}-{name}` id that the badge carries. `DefinitionKind::anchor` (src/lib.rs:82) is the single source for that anchor. When `index_path` is `Some`, the page also gets `[Requirements index](…)`. `populate` links the same pages from the index table rows. - **Reference badges.** `replace_references` (src/lib.rs:384) links `{impl}`, `{cite}` and `{test}` badges to `chapter_href(current, target.path, Some(anchor))`, the definition's anchored badge. - **Names containing `.md`.** `chapter_href` (src/lib.rs:476) uses `with_extension("html")`, so `requirements.cli.mdbook.md` becomes `requirements.cli.mdbook.html`. It then rewrites `.md` to `%2Emd` throughout the href, which stops mdBook treating it as a chapter suffix. The percent-encoded fragment decodes to the real anchor id in the browser. - **Supporting helpers.** `detail_path` and `is_detail_path` support the wiring. `is_detail_path` keeps generated detail pages from being re-processed for definitions. - **Plan wiring.** The `populate` index/sub-chapter wiring and the `preprocess_book` call that passes the plan are covered by the same comment-level markers. **Tests** - `every_definition_gets_a_nested_detail_page_without_an_index` (src/lib.rs:859) covers a requirement, an example and a `cli.mdbook` name, with no index. It checks: - badge `id` plus `href` for each; - the "See evidence" paragraph for each, exactly 3 occurrences; - the `[View definition](../rules.html#habeas-req-rules.zeta)` back-link; - the `%2Emd` form for the `.md`-containing name; - no "Requirements index" link when no index exists. - `index_shows_evidence_states_and_links_generated_chapters` (src/index.rs:1043) covers the with-index case across directories. It checks: - the badge `href` and `id`; - index table links to the detail pages; - the `[Requirements index](../../appendix/requirements-index.html)` back-link; - the `[View definition](../core.html#habeas-req-…)` back-link. - `links_preserve_requirement_names_containing_md` (src/lib.rs:975) tests `chapter_href` in both directions, detail page and definition anchor, for `requirements.cli.mdbook`. - `references_in_nested_chapters_link_to_the_requirement_definition` (src/lib.rs, marked for `book_badges`) verifies that reference badges link to `../requirements.html#habeas-req-requirements.ready`. That covers "reference badges continue to link". **Minor observations (not gaps)** - The reference-badge test is labelled only for `book_badges`, not `navigation`. It does verify the behaviour. - `is_detail_path` is marked as implementing navigation, although it is a helper that stops detail pages being re-processed. This is defensible because it keeps the generated links and pages intact.
